mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (session_id, agent_id, turn, step, role, content, tool_call_id, tool_name, tool_arguments, tool_calls_json, compressed, created_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{agentId}, #{turn}, #{step}, #{role}, #{content}, #{toolCallId}, #{toolName}, #{toolArguments}, #{toolCallsJson}, #{compressed}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_message WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT * FROM chat_message WHERE tool_call_id=#{toolCallId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE session_id=#{sessionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET compressed=#{compressed} WHERE id=#{id}
